description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the Markdown image rendering functionality within the Confluence content type of the Daux documentation generator. It tests both external image URLs and local image attachments rendering outputs.

classes.name: ImageRendererTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the Markdown image rendering functionality in the Confluence content type.

methods.name: provideImageCases
methods.description: Provides test data with Markdown input and expected HTML output for different image scenarios.

methods.name: testRenderImage
methods.description: Runs assertions to verify that images in Markdown are correctly rendered into Confluence storage format.
